programs.description: A labourer named Kuttappan arranges the wedding of his friend's sister to her beloved, Krishnan. Later, he learns of Krishnan's other family and decides to become their caretaker.
Vrinda, a rich young woman, falls in love with Vasu, a poor man. However, he rejects her advances due to his financial status.

When a powerful explosion occurs at the Vilayam beach seconds after Chief Minister Madhavan leaves the venue, Police Officer Rishikesh is tasked with the investigation to find the truth behind the blast.
Kappalu Muthalali
Retirees Omanakuttan Pilla, Cherian Thomas and Mahendran Thambi decide to set up a drama troupe in order to stay active. However, they endure several hurdles and incidents in the process.
After an elephant saves him from an accident in childhood, Krishna becomes fond of elephants. His life changes when he decides to adopt Arjunan, a severely injured elephant.
Alice, a young teacher, is in love with Captain Thomas. However, Thomas suspects that Alice is having an illicit affair with Ravi, one of her students.
Conflicts arise between the heir to a wealthy rural family and his overprotective father. However, hilarity ensues after the heir runs away to the city and gets involved in a series of mishaps.
Raju, a tour guide who works at Kodaikanal, comes across Nimmi, a young girl, and falls in love with her. However, he soon starts uncovering secrets about his own birth and parents.
